summary: Product classification; ghee qualifies as product of livestock under Andhra Pradesh (Agricultural Produce and Livestock) Markets Act, 1966 s.2(v)/s.2(xv); derivative items fall under definition 'products of livestock'; notification validity; G.O.Ms.No.286 (1994) complies with statutory procedure under s.4; distinction between notifications under s.3 (draft notification, public objections) and s.4 (market area declaration) upheld; challenge to notification on procedural grounds rejected; Full Bench decision of Andhra Pradesh High Court affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Andhra Pradesh (Agricultural Produce and Livestock) Markets Act, 1966 s.2(v), s.2(xv), s.3, s.4
Park Leather Industry (P) Ltd. v. State of U.P. (2001) 3 SCC 135
Kishan Lal v. State of Rajasthan, AIR 1990 SC 2269
Ram Chandra Kailash Kumar v. State of U.P. 1980 Supp (1) SCC 27
Smt. Sita Devi (Dead) by LRs. v. State of Bihar & Ors. 1995 Supp (1) SSC 670
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; 1994 notification (G.O.Ms.No.286) upholding ghee as product of livestock under Act sustained.
